summary: Strongest ASX session in weeks: XJO +1.61%, XSO outperforming at +2.27% (regime divergence signal). US-Iran 60-day ceasefire MOU drove WTI toward $87 in Asian hours; SPX at new ATH 7,564 despite PCE 3.8% (3-yr high). EOS +16.18% on defence board appointments with $459M C-UAS order book. Materials led (XMJ +2.89%, MIN +3.76% on POSCO deal close, SGM new 20day high). April CPI 4.2% (below 4.4% consensus) priced out June RBA hike (~95% hold probability) but trimmed mean rose to 3.4%. XJO 160/31 advance/decline (5.2:1) broadest bounce this correction cycle. 30 new 20day highs vs 13 lows - first net-positive H/L session this month. All regimes remain Bearish/Neutral Bear.
